actions.fist_thumb_left: no action - recorded so a thumb-out fist is not mistaken for a fist
actions.fist_thumb_right: no action - recorded so a thumb-out fist is not mistaken for a fist

instructions.none: Relax. Move your hand naturally, rest it, gesture while talking, reach for the keyboard — anything that is NOT a command pose. Vary it every repetition.
instructions.point: Extend only the index finger. Keep the thumb relaxed or tucked near the palm, not straight out to the side: index plus a straight sideways thumb is now the LEFT CLICK pose.
instructions.open_palm: All five fingers extended and spread. Move the palm slowly side to side while recording.
instructions.v_sign: Index and middle extended in a WIDE V. Ring and pinky curled, thumb tucked.
instructions.two_finger_scroll: Index and middle extended and held TOGETHER, touching. Move slowly up and down while recording.
instructions.fist: Closed fist with the thumb tucked across the front of the fingers, not sticking out.
instructions.fist_thumb_up: Closed fist with the thumb extended straight UP.
instructions.fist_thumb_left: Closed fist with the thumb extended sideways to the LEFT.
instructions.fist_thumb_right: Closed fist with the thumb extended sideways to the RIGHT.
instructions.index_thumb: Keep the index finger straight as if pointing. Straighten the thumb out to the SIDE, making an L shape. Curl middle, ring and pinky. Hold this pose throughout recording; do not touch fingertips. Vary wrist angle and height slightly each repetition.

conditions.label: Normal
conditions.instruction: Sit at your usual presenting distance.

conditions.label: Rotated hand
conditions.instruction: Rotate your wrist. Change the tilt each time.

conditions.label: Off-centre
conditions.instruction: Move your hand to a corner of the frame.

left_hand.note: The left hand uses open_palm for controls lock, fist for voice recording, and index_thumb for left click. Keep the same click pose as on the right hand.

quality._min_edge_margin_note: Deliberately just above zero. The gate exists to reject hands clipped by the frame edge, where MediaPipe extrapolates landmarks that were never observed. A larger value would fight the offcentre condition, which asks for exactly that placement.

gate._note: A block starts only after the measured position stays inside its target band for this long. Targets are ratios of the operator's own normal-distance span, calibrated from the first block, because absolute spans are not reachable on every camera.

notes.gesture_change: Protocol v3 replaces pinch and pinch_right with index_thumb and records a clean point pose with the thumb tucked. Remove all old point and pinch rows via research.migrate_gestures, then record --gestures point index_thumb. All other recordings are retained unchanged.
